Game Overview

In Siren Head Nightmare Scary Survival, the core idea is straightforward: escape a haunted mansion pursued by the eerie Siren Head creature. Navigate in tense silence, staying hidden and collecting vital tools to survive multiple nights. With no weapons to defend yourself, listen closely for danger, move cautiously, and uncover the mansion's secrets to evade this relentless hunter.
